authority_layers.scope: A separately exact human ratification may authorize only the registry parser, fake artifacts, fake dispatchers, epoch bridge, receipt validator, action DAG gate, and deterministic fake fault fixtures.
Only named implementation actions under a new exact human authorization, a ratified successor architecture, installed G0 gate, and relevant frozen contracts.

Each first data, tokenizer, model, writer, adapter, merge, checkpoint, candidate, exam, scorer, reporter, or resource action requires its own exact authorization and all action-specific predecessor receipts.
GPU/resource and external-science actions remain separately gated after the cheapest CPU and review receipts.
Claim, publication, push, and opaque release are four distinct actions with distinct human authority; none is implied by science or another terminal action.

action_defaults.receipt_validity: Every receipt must bind the requested action ID, exact input and implementation roots, exact scope, nonce, and nonexpired authority where applicable.
action_defaults.execution_rule: An action may run once only after every direct and transitive prerequisite validates; a passing receipt never widens another action.

internal_invariants.predicate: Action, produced-receipt, and external-receipt IDs are unique; every prerequisite is external or produced by exactly one earlier action.
Every produced prerequisite has a strictly lower topological rank; all actions topologically sort.
G0 authorization binds registry, DAG, parser, issuer, bridge, validator, gate, fakes, dispatchers, faults, path/scope manifests, expected outputs, action, scope, nonce, and expiry.
STATIC_SCHEMA, G0_FAKE_RUNTIME, G1_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW, G2_CPU_DOMAIN, G3_GPU_SCIENCE, and G4_CLAIM receipts guard only later constructible actions.
Every covered G2/G3 generation or execution action requires the exact matched-solo opportunity receipt before it begins.
GPU dispatch requires G1 and G2 phase manifests plus target-blindness, semantic, and noninterference rows under exact GPU authority.
A claim requires G3 and G4 manifests, frozen analysis packet, powered root-level evidence, uncertainty, multiplicity, missingness, safety, extraction/use, and separate exact claim authority.
The candidate sequence is construct, close/stage, evaluate, then one atomic promote-or-no-change action.
No protected action constructs or runs its own G0 gate prerequisite.
External science, claim, publication, push, and release retain separate exact human authorities.
Opaque release equality-binds wrapper, concrete payload class/root, destination, operation, protocol, scope, nonce, expiry, and idempotency.
This DAG authorizes no implementation, execution, GPU, science, claim, publication, push, release, ratification, or intake transition.

test_phase_receipt_schema.failure_policy: Any missing, failed, stale, replayed, wrong-root, or wrong-action row fails closed.

GPU_dispatch_requires: typed target-blindness and bootstrap semantic-audit rows
